effect.name: GM Blurmoco
effect.desc: Curved directional blur trails sampled along a quadratic motion path with chromatic tail control.
effect.shader: vec2 gmEdge(vec2 uv){if(edgeMode==1)return 1.0-abs(mod(uv,2.0)-1.0);if(edgeMode==2)return fract(uv);return clamp(uv,0.0,1.0);} void main(){vec2 uv=acScreenNorm;vec2 screen=max(acScreenSize,vec2(1.0));vec2 dir=vec2(cos(angle),sin(angle));vec2 normal=vec2(-dir.y,dir.x);float count=clamp(floor(samples+0.5),4.0,48.0);vec4 sum=vec4(0.0);float wsum=0.0;for(int i=0;i<48;i++){if(float(i)>=count)break;float u=(float(i)+0.5)/count;float t=centered?(u-0.5)*2.0:u;float arc=t*t*curvature;vec2 path=(dir*t+normal*arc)*lengthPx/screen;float w=exp(-abs(t)*decay)*mix(1.0,1.0-abs(t),taper);vec2 chroma=dir*chromaPx*abs(t)/screen;vec2 suv=gmEdge(uv-path);vec4 c=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,suv);if(chromaPx>0.0){c.r=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,gmEdge(suv+chroma)).r;c.b=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,gmEdge(suv-chroma)).b;}sum+=c*w;wsum+=w;}gl_FragColor=sum/max(wsum,0.0001);}
